Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Communications Trainee position at Detergents Europe. With a background in digital marketing, web design, and content creation, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your communications plan and support the visibility of the cleaning and hygiene products industry.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress sites. I have hands-on experience with CMS platforms, social media integration, and analytics tools like Google Analytics and Search Console. My personal project, mirook.com, showcases my ability to implement structured data and optimize for AI-powered search, demonstrating my interest in emerging digital tools.

I am proactive, organized, and eager to learn. I am comfortable working independently and as part of a team, and I am ready to take on project coordination and content creation tasks. I am based in Belgium and available to work in Brussels.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to your team.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Communications Trainee position at Detergents Europe. As a junior digital marketer with a strong foundation in web design, SEO, and content creation, I am drawn to the opportunity to support the communications of an industry that plays a vital role in health and hygiene across Europe.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained practical experience in managing digital channels. I handle on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, and write keyword-targeted blog content that drives organic traffic. I also build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and the Astra theme, ensuring content is accurate and user-friendly. My work involves tracking performance with tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, SEMrush, and Ahrefs, and using those insights to improve reach and engagement.

My personal project, mirook.com, has allowed me to explore innovative digital communications. I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site, implemented structured data (JSON-LD) to enhance visibility in both traditional and AI-powered search engines, and integrated social media. This project reflects my interest in new media trends and emerging tools, including AI-powered content creation.

I am proactive, organized, and detail-oriented, with a project management mindset. I am comfortable working both independently and as part of a multicultural team, and I thrive under time pressure. My fluency in English, combined with my technical skills, makes me well-prepared to contribute to your communications activities.

I am eager to bring my creativity and commitment to high-quality work to Detergents Europe. Thank you for considering my application; I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can support your team.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
